evidence.quote: For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued. All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2.

lost_or_added_conditions: The executable child formalizes only the trigger; the mandatory performance duty remains unencoded, so complete parent satisfaction cannot be computed.
The proposal retains the source's unspecified resubmission timing and linkage requirements as explicit residual questions.

The proposal adds an evidentiary requirement for time-of-day classification of implementation, which is a stated interpretation of the 9:00am launch boundary rather than a substantive change to the duty.
value.rationale: The decomposition preserves the licensed-firm actor, off-channel submission condition, post-implementation timing, mandatory separate STREAMS 2 resubmission, and distinction from automatic migration and blackout contacts. It appropriately leaves performance timing and linkage unresolved. Because performance is marked unencoded and the trigger's Boolean result is expressly not treated as full parent compliance, the proposal preserves meaning with stated residuals rather than establishing complete executable satisfaction.
